6 of 8 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Retirement Plan Investment Performance — Q4 Review

The committee considered the Retirement Plan Investment Performance — Q4 Review, a proposal to adopt a new policy on corporate political activity. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Item 2
Regional Business Review: Americas

The committee discussed the Regional Business Review: Americas, a review of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The committee reviewed the company's periodic reports and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To approve for leveraging: RESOLVED, that the Credit Risk Management Committee authorizes a share repurchase program of up to $31M of the company's common stock.

Moved: Cristina Fujiwara  •  Seconded: Qian Chaudhuri
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Public Policy Priorities for FY2017

The Public Policy Priorities for FY2017 was a review of the company's customer satisfaction scores. The scores had declined by 18% in the 6 region. The committee requested a detailed action plan from the regional leadership team.

Item 4
Workforce Reduction Planning — Notification Requirements

The Workforce Reduction Planning — Notification Requirements was a review of the company's customer satisfaction scores. The scores had declined by 18% in the 6 region. The committee requested a detailed action plan from the regional leadership team.
